caption: The drawing depicts a single shallow, round metal bowl with a reddish-brown exterior and an interior that shows a mix of colors including gold, blue, and brown, indicating reflections or tarnish commonly seen on copper or brass objects. The bowl has a thick rim and is rendered with a sense of depth and dimension. Attached to the bowl is a short, flat, dark handle with a round hole near its end. The bowl is positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background, and there are no other objects present in the drawing. At the bottom, faint handwriting is visible, featuring a signature and the date "1938."
title: Child's Porringer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
